Template builder fixes and improvements.

### What's changed
- **Card backgrounds.** Choosing a background picture now works with any picture Windows can open (PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, BMP or SVG), and the picture fills the card without being squashed: a picture of a different shape is trimmed at the edges. The red "stretched to fit" warning is gone. Logos accept the same picture types.
- **Layer order.** Under **Arrange**, bring a selected item **To front**, **Forward**, **Backward** or **To back**, or use Ctrl+] and Ctrl+[ (with Shift for front and back).
- **Opacity.** Fade any item on the card, and the background picture, with an opacity slider.
- **Text stays inside its box.** Long names shrink to the template's smallest size, then move onto two lines (also after a hyphen, as in Smith-Jones), then shrink further, instead of running outside their box.
- **Licence.** The licence is accepted once, in the setup. The program no longer asks again the first time it's opened.

Existing installs keep all their templates, clients and people. Templates whose background picture wasn't the card's shape now show it trimmed rather than stretched.

### Updating
An administrator will see **Version 3.0.8 is available** at the top of the program — choose **Update now**. Or download the setup below and run it over the top.

### New install
Download **ID-Card-Printing-Software-Free-Setup-3.0.8.exe** below and run it. The setup isn't code-signed, so the first time Windows may show *Windows protected your PC*: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**, then **Yes**.
